"""Run only the approved P0 built-in Windows metadata query; never SDKs or network."""
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

R = Path(__file__).parent
EXE = Path('C:/Windows/System32/WindowsPowerShell/v1.0/powershell.exe')

def now():
    return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()

def save(name, value):
    with (R / name).open('x', encoding='utf-8', newline='\n') as f:
        json.dump(value, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=True)
        f.write('\n')

assert not (R / 'command.json').exists(), 'One-shot inventory already attempted; preserve evidence'
baseline = json.loads((R / 'baseline.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert hashlib.sha256(EXE.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == baseline['powershell_sha256'], 'Built-in executable changed; no process launched'
script = (R / 'inventory.ps1').read_bytes()
env = os.environ.copy()
env['PSModulePath'] = str(EXE.parent / 'Modules')
env['PSModuleAnalysisCachePath'] = str(R / 'module-analysis-cache')
(R / 'temp').mkdir()
env['TEMP'] = env['TMP'] = str(R / 'temp')
argv = [str(EXE), '-NoProfile', '-NonInteractive', '-Command', script.decode('utf-8')]
meta = {'started_at_utc': now(), 'executable': str(EXE), 'executable_sha256': baseline['powershell_sha256'], 'arguments': ['-NoProfile', '-NonInteractive', '-Command', '$UTF8_CONTENT_OF_inventory.ps1'], 'script_sha256': hashlib.sha256(script).hexdigest(), 'timeout_seconds': 150, 'scope': 'Local allowlisted metadata only; no remote CIM target, network request, SDK, installation or elevation; environment isolation is not an OS sandbox'}
save('command.json', meta)
process = subprocess.Popen(argv, cwd=R, env=env, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
timed_out = False
try:
    out, err = process.communicate(timeout=150)
except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
    timed_out = True
    process.kill()  # Only this owned PowerShell PID; never shared WMI/ADB services.
    out, err = process.communicate(timeout=10)
(R / 'stdout.txt').write_bytes(out)
(R / 'stderr.txt').write_bytes(err)
save('exit.json', {'finished_at_utc': now(), 'exit_code': process.returncode, 'timed_out': timed_out, 'owned_powershell_exited': process.poll() is not None, 'stdout_bytes': len(out), 'stderr_bytes': len(err), 'stdout_sha256': hashlib.sha256(out).hexdigest(), 'stderr_sha256': hashlib.sha256(err).hexdigest()})
assert not timed_out, 'P0 timed out; outputs retained; no automatic retry or elevation'
assert process.returncode == 0, 'P0 stopped/failed; outputs retained; no automatic retry or elevation'
assert not err, 'Unexpected stderr retained; inspect before any further action'
data = json.loads(out.decode('utf-8-sig'))
save('inventory.json', data)
print(json.dumps(data, indent=2, ensure_ascii=True))

"""Validate saved allowlisted P0 output and capture once; never repeat host queries."""
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

R = Path(__file__).parent
REPO = Path('$REPO_ROOT')
OUT = REPO / 'docs/cookbook/evidence/m00-t05-windows-inventory.json'
assert not OUT.exists(), 'Immutable output already exists'
def sha(raw):
    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
def load(name):
    return json.loads((R / name).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
base = load('baseline.json')
assert len(base['snapshots']) == 11
for name, digest in base['snapshots'].items():
    assert sha((OUT.parent / name).read_bytes()) == digest, name
for name, digest in base['repo_file_sha256'].items():
    assert sha((REPO / name).read_bytes()) == digest, name
raw = (R / 'stdout.txt').read_bytes()
data = load('inventory.json')
assert json.loads(raw.decode('utf-8-sig')) == data
assert data['token_is_administrator'] is False
allowed = {
    'os': {'caption', 'version', 'build', 'architecture', 'visible_memory_bytes', 'available_memory_bytes'},
    'os_release': {'display_version', 'update_build_revision'},
    'cpu': {'model', 'architecture_code', 'cores', 'logical_processors', 'virtualization_firmware_enabled', 'slat', 'vm_monitor_mode_extensions'},
    'system': {'reported_physical_memory_bytes', 'hypervisor_present'},
    'installed_memory': {'module_capacity_sum_bytes'},
    'temporary_volume': {'role', 'capacity_bytes', 'free_bytes'},
    'checkout_volume': {'role', 'capacity_bytes', 'free_bytes'},
    'graphics': {'model', 'driver_version'},
}
assert set(data) == {'started_at_utc', 'finished_at_utc', 'token_is_administrator', 'status', 'groups'}
assert set(data['groups']) == set(allowed)
for name, fields in allowed.items():
    group = data['groups'][name]
    assert set(group) == {'status', 'data'} and group['status'] == 'Observed'
    assert set(group['data']) == fields, name
    assert all(value is not None for value in group['data'].values()), name
exit_record = load('exit.json')
assert exit_record['exit_code'] == 0 and not exit_record['timed_out'] and exit_record['owned_powershell_exited']
assert exit_record['stdout_sha256'] == sha(raw)
assert (R / 'stderr.txt').read_bytes() == b'' and exit_record['stderr_bytes'] == 0
assert exit_record['stderr_sha256'] == sha(b'')
command = load('command.json')
assert command['script_sha256'] == sha((R / 'inventory.ps1').read_bytes())
assert command['executable_sha256'] == base['powershell_sha256']
script = (R / 'inventory.ps1').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
assert script.count("Read-Group '") == 8
assert script.count('SELECT ') == 7
assert 'SELECT *' not in script and '-ComputerName' not in script and '-CimSession' not in script
assert "OpenSubKey('SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows NT\\CurrentVersion', $false)" in script
assert '.GetValue(' in script and '.SetValue(' not in script
files = []
